levels.name: Plan 2
other_names: OBC concourse above/next to the tracks
levels.note: DSB's label ('DSB 7-Eleven, Plan 2'); the 7-Eleven address is 'OBC, Østre Stationsvej 27,2'. OSM puts DSB Salg & Service (OSM name 'DSB Rejsecenter'), the 7-Eleven IC unit, the cafés and the heads of the three platform escalators and two platform lifts on level 2. Whether 'Plan 2' is signposted in the building is not confirmed.

open: Station vs mall: only units on the OBC concourse level (Plan 2) within about 25 m of the platform escalators per OSM, plus the two DSB-listed 7-Elevens, are included. Excluded as OBC mall shops: McDonald's, Mr. Fried Chicken, DanØst Marked (all OSM level 0), D'let (OSM level 1), Banegårdens Shawarma (OBC tenant list, not in OSM), Nordisk Film Biografer, Borgernes Hus/Hovedbiblioteket. No owner text says which units count as station.
Hours missing for Joe & The Juice and The Food Stall (no own-site page found; thefoodstall.dk is an empty WordPress page); Espresso House, Apoteket, Cover City, Smart Things, Ria hours are OSM only.
7-Eleven stueplan: 7-Eleven list and DSB page disagree on hours (see hours_conflict).
Toilet price/hours not given by DSB (run by ATP building).

Which platform the third Byens Bro lift (n4039768513) serves, and whether there is a concourse lift to platform 3, is not settled: OSM links concourse lifts only to platforms 1 and 2. DSB says only 'Elevator via OBC'.
Signposting of 'Plan 2'/'stueplan' inside OBC not confirmed (DSB text only).
Platform numbering: OSM platform refs 1/2/3 = perron 1 (spor 3/4), 2 (spor 5/6), 3 (spor 7/8) per the register; DSB uses 'spor 7/8'.
No published station plan (DSB, Banedanmark, Midttrafik/FynBus/NT) found on 2026-10-30; DSB publishes access only as present/absent lines. Level heights: no source measures them.
